page: Microsoft Azure HB176-48rs_v4 is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the HBv4 server family. It features 48 dedicated vCPUs managed via the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The system is equipped with 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding a high memory-to-core ratio of 16.0 GB per vCPU.

This server configuration includes 4332 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, eliminating the need for external storage attachments for high-throughput local operations. Additionally, the instance is RDMA capable and supports Premium Storage, enabling low-latency networking and high-speed storage access. No dedicated GPU hardware is present on this instance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of a high memory-to-vCPU ratio and substantial local NVMe SSD storage provides a dense resource profile for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads without the overhead of separate storage provisioning. The hardware profile is designed for workloads such as large-scale databases, memory-intensive data processing, and high-performance computing tasks requiring RDMA networking.
